add.title: Jennifer, la mujer trans que sobrevivio a las torturas en las carceles del regimen de excepcion (GatoEncerrado)
add.summary: GatoEncerrado (Oscar Hernandez, 26 Feb 2024): since the state of exception began (Mar 2022), trans women arbitrarily captured in mass raids are held in the ordinary prison system with no gender-identity accommodation. Jennifer, arrested 14 Apr 2022 in San Salvador, was held first at the 'El Penalito' police lockups and then in prison, where custodians forcibly shaved her hair ('para que sepan lo que son'), singled her out with another trans woman (Rosa) for outdoor punishment drills (handcuffed, forced squatting in the sun), and denied her HIV clinic access; a judge freed her after ~4 months finding the arrest unsupported, while Rosa remains imprisoned. Organisations (Socorro Juridico Humanista, Cristosal) link the abuse to the absence of a Gender Identity Law. Documents birth-sex placement in the general prison system with trans-targeted abuse and no special custody provision.
